fieldValues.title: Rendered order is controlled; restore it
fieldValues.decision_question: Is a change in rendered order that nobody chose a bug, or the new correct order?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's working session on 2026-10-10 (the owner was away from a computer); awaiting the owner's ratification. Since srs-rust build 414, sections with no declared ordering render their children in a different sequence (Field now before Type). The spec reads differently depending on the build.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: A: restore the earlier meaningful order (a bug fix). B: accept the new order as correct under "order is data", which makes it a ruling and a corpus change. Chosen: A.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Rendered output order must be controllable; unpredictable output is a bug. Restore a meaningful order (previously driven by precedes).
fieldValues.rationale: We need to be able to control the order of our rendered output. Accepting an order nobody chose would turn an accident into policy.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When revision-8 container ordering (RFC-043) declares the order of these sections, so no fallback order is needed.
